title: Splash
tagline: Splash is a platform that allows users to invest by watching their favourite content - watch to invest!
description:
Splash is a platform that allows users to invest by watching their favourite content. Behind the hood, viewer get streamed an interest-bearing token (erc20) for every second they watch.

This creates a compelling financial incentive for viewers putting in time and attention.

Users can also sponsor other users' videos to in return for a 10 second advertisement played before the start of the video. 

Viewer who watch ads get streamed the sponsor's token on a per second basis for the length of the video. They then get streamed interest-bearing tokens for watching the main video.
how_its_made: This project uses PolygonID for ZK Verification of users, WorldCoin for Proof of Personhood (to prevent bots), Aluo to stream interest-bearing tokens to viewers, The Graph to query video metadata and query Lens Profiles, Livepeer for video storage and display, and Web3 Storage for thumbnail uploads.
